commit.message:
UX Wave 6 · WP7: close the ratelimit release rollover race, drop stale references (#1112, #1114, #1150) (#1162)

* fix(crush): close ratelimit release rollover race, drop stale refs (#1112, #1114, #1150)

- ratelimit: the window generation token now expires a second before the
  counter. Written after the counter's add() with the same timeout, it
  outlived the counter, so a release could pass the token check, decrement
  a counter a new window had already re-created, and never give the slot
  back (one free request in the new window). New regression test.
- Repoint triggerRawBtPrint references (atmos KDS template, atmos view,
  CSP comment in settings) from the removed alpine-components.js to
  alpine/coach.js; AGENTS.md now points the mixin helper at alpine/shared.js.
- home.html: drop the empty extra_css override whose comment cited a
  non-existent css/pages/home.css.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01RnTNnvoEqhZYgBscUEg9QK

* docs(crush): note ratelimit token edge cases, guard LocMem-only test (#1150)

Document that a 1s period cannot expire the generation token early and
that reservations counted in a window's last second are never released.
Skip the rollover regression test unless the default cache is LocMemCache,
since it drives LocMem expiry internals.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01RnTNnvoEqhZYgBscUEg9QK

* fix(crush): tie ratelimit releases to the counter's own window deadline (#1150)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01RnTNnvoEqhZYgBscUEg9QK
